svg.title: GitHub activity — 948 contributions shown in the last year
svg.desc: Snapshot for anhnam26. 6 public repositories, 9 stars on owned non-fork repositories. Calendar 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-13. Updated 13 Oct 2026 (UTC+7). Red and blue teams play three one-minute matches beneath the calendar, with a central scoreboard and fixed 3–2 results.

svg.title: Red versus blue — three one-minute matches
svg.desc: A fixed three-minute loop. Red wins football 3–2, blue wins basketball 3–2, and red wins volleyball 3–2. Two players per side face the ball. Football and basketball restart with the conceding team; volleyball serves go to the point winner. Every scoring play counts as one point.

g.text: 60s PER SPORT / FIRST TO 3 / RED LEFT · BLUE RIGHT
